verdict.rationale: Gazebo installs and runs entirely on the user's own machines: binary packages (gz-jetty metapackage, ROS vendor packages), a source-based install path, a lightweight GUI-free gz-sim-server package for headless/CI use, a server-only -s flag, and remote-server operation via Gazebo Transport, all from a public GitHub repo. missing for 10: an explicit open-source license statement in the evidence, independent or hands-on corroboration of self-hosted deployments.
